name: mdp-snippets
description: Inline code completions driven by a Markov Decision Process: a token Markov chain learns your code, Q-learning learns which suggestions you accept. Press Tab to accept.

mdpSnippets.order.description: Markov context size in tokens. Changing this resets the model.

mdpSnippets.candidates.description: Candidate actions per state (cycle with 'Show Next Inline Suggestion').

mdpSnippets.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in a generated snippet.

mdpSnippets.maxLines.description: Max lines a suggestion may span.

mdpSnippets.minCount.description: Minimum observations before a context may vote.

mdpSnippets.minConfidence.description: Minimum smoothed token probability during beam search.

mdpSnippets.smoothing.description: World-model smoothing: Kneser-Ney (absolute discounting + continuation backoff) or plain interpolated backoff.

mdpSnippets.transferWeight.description: Write-weight of the universal '*' transfer channel (levels 1-2).

mdpSnippets.familyTransferWeight.description: Write-weight of the language-FAMILY channel. Hierarchical transfer: language -> family -> universal.

mdpSnippets.transferLearn.description: Learn per-language transfer weights (self/family/universal) by multiplicative weights on live prediction accuracy.

mdpSnippets.transferEta.description: Learning rate of the transfer weights.

mdpSnippets.cache.description: Per-document dynamic identifier cache mixed into the model.

mdpSnippets.cacheD.description: Cache mixing constant: lambda = mass/(mass + D).

mdpSnippets.diversityLambda.description: MMR diversity penalty when selecting the candidate slate.

mdpSnippets.alphaMode.description: Learning-rate schedule: fixed, Robbins-Monro 1/N, or the Kalman gain.

mdpSnippets.beta.description: Weight of the Markov prior in ranking.

mdpSnippets.weightAlpha.description: Learning rate for the linear preference head.

mdpSnippets.rankBy.description: Ranking objective: expected value, P(accept), or CVaR (risk-averse).

mdpSnippets.distEta.description: EMA rate for per-(s,a) reward histograms.

mdpSnippets.valueObjective.description: Discounted returns or average reward (R-learning with learned rho).

mdpSnippets.rhoAlpha.description: Learning rate for the average-reward estimate.

mdpSnippets.processNoise.description: Kalman process noise: uncertainty regrows over time.

mdpSnippets.obsNoise.description: Kalman observation noise per reward signal.

mdpSnippets.factorDim.description: Latent dimension of the low-rank value model (0 = off).

mdpSnippets.factorEta.description: Learning rate of the low-rank value model.

mdpSnippets.driftThreshold.description: CUSUM drift alarm threshold; on alarm, process noise is injected.

mdpSnippets.rewardAccept.description: Reward when a suggestion is accepted with Tab.

mdpSnippets.rewardDismiss.description: Reward when a suggestion is dismissed.

mdpSnippets.rewardEscape.description: Reward for an explicit Esc dismissal.

mdpSnippets.rewardOverridden.description: Reward for candidates passed over while cycling (0 = off).

mdpSnippets.timeReward.description: Modulate reward by time-to-Tab (fast x1.25, slow x0.75).

mdpSnippets.utilityReward.description: Scale acceptance reward by keystrokes saved.

mdpSnippets.correctionReward.description: Reward when you edit inside a just-accepted snippet.

mdpSnippets.watchWindow.description: Seconds an accepted snippet is watched for corrections.

mdpSnippets.confirmReward.description: Small positive reward when a watched snippet survives untouched.

mdpSnippets.minVisitsGate.description: State visits required before the gate can engage.

mdpSnippets.gateProbe.description: Probability of showing a gated suggestion anyway (censored-feedback probing).

mdpSnippets.adaptiveGate.description: Controller nudging the nuisance threshold to hold the target accept rate.

mdpSnippets.targetAcceptRate.description: Target accept+partial rate for the gate controller.

mdpSnippets.gateStep.description: Step size of the gate controller.

mdpSnippets.gateAudit.description: Counterfactual gate audit: probe outcomes can relax an over-tight gate.

mdpSnippets.refactorBias.description: Mute suggestions while the session-mode belief says you are refactoring.

mdpSnippets.countDecay.description: Periodic decay of transition counts (1 = never forget).

mdpSnippets.decayEvery.description: Apply decay every N learning events.

mdpSnippets.dynaBatch.description: Synthetic Dyna updates per planning tick.

mdpSnippets.dynaEvery.description: Planning tick every N learning events.

mdpSnippets.rolloutSteps.description: Options-style macro-action: greedy rollout of N statement segments (0 = off).

mdpSnippets.lookahead.description: Plan snippets with PUCT tree search: the Markov chain proposes, the learned value ensemble guides.

mdpSnippets.lookaheadDepth.description: Maximum tokens planned per lookahead snippet.

mdpSnippets.undoWindow.description: Seconds after acceptance during which deleting most of the snippet reverses the reward.

mdpSnippets.undoFrac.description: Fraction of the snippet that must be deleted to count as remorse.

mdpSnippets.adaptiveLength.description: Auto-tune the effective snippet cap from accepted/dismissed lengths.

mdpSnippets.autoExploit.description: Let off-policy evaluation lock exploration off when greedy is confidently better.

mdpSnippets.sessionLog.description: Append every learning transition to session-log.jsonl (hashed states).

mdpSnippets.worker.description: Run snippet generation in a worker thread (requires tsc output out/worker.js; disable for the single-file bun bundle).

mdpSnippets.workerTimeout.description: Ms to wait for the generation worker before falling back.

mdpSnippets.workspaceConditioning.description: Per-workspace Q-states that read through to the global table as a prior.

mdpSnippets.fittedQ.description: Fitted-Q warm start: replay the persisted buffer at startup.

mdpSnippets.fittedQEpochs.description: Epochs of fitted-Q iteration per warm start.

mdpSnippets.actionKeyMode.description: Action identity: hybrid (shape Q + per-literal residual), shape only, or literal. Pre-v9 files migrate automatically.

mdpSnippets.debounceMs.description: Debounce window: one generation per typing burst (0 = off).

mdpSnippets.maxDebounceMs.description: Hard cap on total debounce delay.

mdpSnippets.datasetWeight.description: Weight of dataset/corpus transitions relative to your typing. Datasets teach the transition model only.

mdpSnippets.datasetMaxFiles.description: Maximum files learned per folder run.

mdpSnippets.datasetMaxFileMb.description: Skip corpus files larger than this.

mdpSnippets.tuneTokenBudget.description: Token cap for throwaway models during order search.

mdpSnippets.languages.description: Language IDs to learn/suggest in. Empty = all.

mdpSnippets.langOverrides.description: Per-language config overrides. Overridable: enabled, candidates, maxTokens, maxLines, minCount, minConfidence, beamWidth, suggestOnNewline, rolloutSteps, diversityLambda, lookahead, lookaheadBudget, lookaheadDepth, lookaheadCPuct.

mdpSnippets.suggestOnNewline.description: Suggest the next line at end of line.

mdpSnippets.persist.description: Persist the model to global storage.

mdpSnippets.debug.description: Verbose logging to the output channel.

mdpSnippets.maxFileKb.description: Skip learning files larger than this.

scripts.compile:fast: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir out --target node --format cjs --external vscode
